title: fix(a11y): resolve accessibility anti-pattern on dialog backdrops
body:
[Issues]
Many custom dialogs (such as `PasteSpecialDialog.svelte`, `CalendarDeleteEntryDialog.svelte`, and `CalendarCreateEntryDialog.svelte`) were binding `onkeydown` event handlers directly to background overlay `div`s that had `role="presentation"`. Attaching interactive event handlers to elements marked as presentational is an accessibility anti-pattern because screen readers do not recognize them as interactive elements capable of receiving focus or keyboard input.

[Changes]
*   Modified `client/src/components/PasteSpecialDialog.svelte` to use `<svelte:window onkeydown={onKeydown} />` instead of binding it to the backdrop `div`.
*   Modified `client/src/components/calendar/CalendarDeleteEntryDialog.svelte` to apply the same fix.
*   Modified `client/src/components/calendar/CalendarCreateEntryDialog.svelte` to apply the same fix.

[Verification Results]
*   Verified string replacements using `git diff`.
*   Ran `cd client && npm run lint` and `npx svelte-check` successfully without warnings or errors.
*   Ran unit and integration test suites via `cd client && npx vitest run`; all 2376 tests passed.
*   Received code review approval.
